method: Add every original face across the old boundary edges once. Require a single manifold disk. Preserve all existing local float32 vertices; pin newly introduced source corners to stored registered source coordinates before local storage. Freeze the new outer boundary; formerly frozen edges may now be bisected. At most 16 adaptive rounds, 5000 vertices and 10000 triangles. Choose the lexicographic best (root alerts, previous-region alerts, all alerts, maximum centre gap). New outer-region alerts are counted separately; they are not hidden by core improvement.

limits: A passing old core can coexist with alerts in its newly added outer ring
Counts on different meshes and different spatial scopes are not anatomical accuracy estimates
Fixed-tissue synthetic subdivisions do not add acquired anatomical observations, activity or delays
Positive sampled Jacobians and normals do not certify entire interiors, volume, self-intersections or global injectivity
All previews overlap the unchanged cortex and may overlap one another; no unified mesh is applied
Outer source corners have recorded float32 rounding; shared interior vertex indices are identical
